documents.title: Bambu ABS Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu ABS Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724B00
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: ABS
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 28 ± 2 MPa, elongation 4.7 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 1590 ± 100 MPa, bending strength 39 ± 4 MPa, impact 7.4 ± 1.2 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density and melting temperature are raw-material properties (DSC, ISO 1183).

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2200 ± 190 MPa, Z 1960 ± 110 MPa), melt index 34.2 ± 3.8 g/10 min (260 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption rate 0.65 % (25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, heat deflection temperature 87 °C at 0.45 MPa, spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), bed surface preparation glue, retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, chamber temperature 45 - 60 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is the printer chamber key), max overhang angle ~ 70°, max bridging length ~ 40 mm, X1 Series heatbed drying 90 - 100 °C 12 h, suggested annealing 80 to 90 °C for 6 to 12 hours, odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.
SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "B00-xx", CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport.
not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the glass transition temperature; filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched.

Hex: the hex table also lists Purple (#AF1685), which has no option value on the store page, so it is not recorded. The table names colours without codes; each is matched to the store value by its colour name.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/d5819343c6f64960816359062604017a/Bambu_ABS_RoHS.pdf) that was not cached; safety.certifications is left to review.
